skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of responsibility accounting, cost determination methods, and product pricing.
Determine unit production costs and selling prices using various cost determination methods.
Analyze accounting information suitable for short-term business decisions and long-term investment decisions.
Understand the concept of responsibility accounting and its role in evaluating business performance.
Understand the concept and role of the balanced scorecard in evaluating business performance.
Proficiency in writing departmental reports and business results reports using cost determination methods and balanced scorecards.
Proficiency in working independently and in teams.
Self-direct learning and take responsibility for personal study outcomes.
